brief.title: GTM tech stack: What it is and how to build one
brief.summary: A GTM tech stack is the set of tools a company uses to run go-to-market activities across the customer lifecycle. These platforms can make it easier to connect marketing, sales, and customer teams. But, if the pieces aren’t compatible, a business’ GTM tech stack is just another layer of disconnected tools. The difference comes down to how the stack is built.
